page.overview:
What is Jack-O-Moon?

Jack-O-Moon is one of the halloween animatronics and a minor antagonist that first appeared in Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2. He is a Halloween-themed variant of the Moon side of the Daycare Attendant.

Jack-O-Moon shares a similar style to the Halloween Animatronics. He sports the Sun's rays around his face, with them now colored purple. His face is colored half pumpkin orange, half grey. His pants now have dirt covering them and look to be made out of potato sacks, giving him a scarecrow-like appearance. His pants have holes which have been repaired/covered with a dark grey colored fabric. His eyes and mouth show a burning fire from inside of his head. His body features a dusty grey colour and also features a dim orange color and his boots have a purple shade and yellow moons overlaying on them.

Jack-O-Moon first appears in the Captain Foxy's Log Ride level. There are three Helpy cutouts in total that can be hit, taking the player to alternate paths. Jack-O-Moon resides in all of them, and must be stopped before he either makes his way to the log flume, or the player is close enough for Jack-O-Moon to attack. This can be done by either hitting a yellow panel to close a door or window, or activating lights that cause him to flee.

He also appears in the Cinder Carousel level, a hardmode variant of the original. Replacing the original Moon, Jack-O-Moon stalks the player and has to have the flashlight shined on him to scare him off. Aside from the carousel being on fire, the game plays relatively the same.
